title: Production Operations & SRE
intro: SRE and production-operations interview questions cover the role that owns reliability for every modern Java backend — incident response and runbooks, postmortems and the blameless culture, on-call rotation design, error budgets and SLO-driven engineering, capacity planning, chaos engineering, the production-debug toolkit (jstack, jmap, async-profiler, JFR, eBPF), and the questions interviewers ask to test calm under pressure ("P0 fires — walk me through the first 15 minutes"). Pair this with the Observability page for the full production-engineering surface.
